verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA agent framework (bundled with Ryzen AI ecosystem) provides a chat-based Agent UI and voice integration (Whisper ASR + Kokoro TTS) that let users issue natural-language commands to control agents and tools running on the Ryzen 9950X3D platform. This is software-layer evidence rather than a CPU-native feature, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of the natural-language experience. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of natural-language control working in practice, and clearer tie between the CPU hardware itself (vs. the separate GAIA software) and the NL interface.
